verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph exposes a driveItem createLink API to programmatically create sharing links [onedrive-docs-13][onedrive-docs-19][onedrive-docs-29], and external sharing settings are documented [onedrive-docs-9], but the evidence pack never shows the specific parameters (password protection, expiry date, revoke/delete-link endpoint) needed to fulfill the full story. Missing for 10: documented password-protected link creation, expiration settings on links, and an API to revoke/delete a sharing link, plus any independent/hands-on confirmation these work as described.
